notes.title: Version 3.0.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear player,

We are very excited to announce an updated version of [i][b]Legend of the Phoenix[/b][/i] with its new features and gameplay. 

Come and discover the [b]new “Land System”[/b] in which you can build your dream home and enjoy a peaceful country life. 

Besides, several brand [b]new gameplay[/b] awaits you to experience! 

Now, let's take a look at the picture illustrations well prepared by Orange Meow for you！

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Ladies,
In order to provide you with a better and more enjoyable game environment and experience, the server will be suspended for service maintenance and update on 25.05.2022. The whole process will last for about 60 minutes. During this period, players will not be able to log into the game. To avoid unnecessary loss, it is better to log off the game before the maintenance begins. The maintenance benefits will be issued after the maintenance.

【New Functions】
Recently, a new dim sum shop has been added to the courtyard, which is specially used to store all kinds of dim sum. And as the little guard to protect these pastries is our orange meow!
Orange Meow's new task - protect the snack shop, the more rats you kill, the more Meow coins you get~

【New Pet Furniture】
The warehouse has added furniture~
Newly added: Kitty Fleece Rug, Pink Wool Rug, Rattan Bear Bed, Berry Berry Milk Carton, Pink Paws Wheel, Dolphin Cat Tree, Banana Cat Scratcher, Musician Cat Scratcher, Barrier Cat Litter Box, Star Travel Cat Litter Box, Jade Waves Cat Bowl, Sakura Wooden Bowl.

【New Outfit】
Elegant Cheongsam, Twinkling Stars, Fawn With Flowers.

【More Outfits for Dyeing】
Purple Haze, Phoenix Auguring Well, Nile Riverbank, Ink-painted Dream, Green Lotus Clothing.
More outfits to be unlocked. Stay tuned.

【Optimization Adjustment】
1. Guild Feast preparation task shows the name of the recipient.
2. Fix some known bugs.
